snippet.title: Gods, Death & Reapers - Official Gamescom Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Gods, Death & Reapers (formerly known as Project Pantheon) on Steam and sign up for Closed Alpha: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086590

Gods, Death & Reapers is an ExtrAction RPG that throws you into a brutal afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are gone. Starting with Norse mythology, Death himself has chosen you to help restore balance to realms left in chaos.

For more information visit https://www.playgdr.com.
